violations.text: Establishment is lacking an allergen statement. Allergen statement must be posted. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Working containers of ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The doors to the restrooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils were moved at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025
The door to the kitchen toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet room doors must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Establishment is to install an air gap. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2024
